result = [x for x in items if x is not None and x != excluded]

for i, val in enumerate(result):
    ws.cell(row=2+i, column=3, value=val)

wb.save(dst)
```

import sys
import openpyxl

src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

# All items from B except the excluded one, in their original order
result = [x for x in items if x != exclude]

# Clear and fill answer range C2

for r in range(start, start + len(result)):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=result[r - start])
# Clear remaining cells in the answer range up to max_row
for r in range(start + len(result), n + 1):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=None)

wb.save(dst)
```
